source.name: Illixion Apps
source.subtitle: iPhone and iPad apps by Illixion
source.description: Apps by Illixion that are not on the App Store yet: Convolution, Longwave and Worldcast. Add this source to AltStore or SideStore to install and update them.
source.tagline: Apps for Apple Vision Pro, iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, made by one developer.

apps.name: Convolution
apps.subtitle: Photo, video and film library
apps.localizedDescription: Browse your Photos library, a Stash, Nextcloud or Jellyfin server, or local files, and play films with real object audio. The 2D-to-3D conversion features need Apple Vision Pro; on iPhone and iPad you get the library, viewer and film player.
apps.requires: Photos library, or a Stash, Nextcloud or Jellyfin server
explainer: Convolution is one library for pictures, video and films. Point it at your Photos library, a Stash, Nextcloud or Jellyfin server, or a folder of local files, and browse them in a grid that keeps each image's real proportions.

Films play with their object audio intact, so overhead sounds stay overhead and move with your head instead of being folded down to 7.1. On Vision Pro it also turns flat photos and videos into 3D. That part needs the headset; the iPhone and iPad app is the library, viewer and film player.

apps.name: Longwave
apps.subtitle: Remote desktop and game streaming
apps.localizedDescription: Connect to your computers from iPhone and iPad: VNC remote desktop, game streaming from a Sunshine or GameStream host, and an SSH terminal. This build is the iPhone and iPad app only; it needs a host on your network or reachable over a VPN.
apps.requires: A computer to connect to, on your network or over a VPN
explainer: Longwave connects you to your computers. It does VNC remote desktop, streams games from a Sunshine or GameStream host, and gives you an SSH terminal, with audio coming along.
On Vision Pro the desktops and terminals sit in the room as windows you place where you want them. On iPhone and iPad it is the same set of connections on a flat screen.

apps.name: Worldcast
apps.subtitle: Single-user podcast listener
apps.localizedDescription: The iPhone and iPad client for a Worldcast server, a self-hosted podcast listener for one person. It needs your own Worldcast server to sign in to. The Apple Watch app is not part of this build.
explainer: Worldcast is a podcast listener for one person. A small Node.js server you run keeps your subscriptions and progress, and a web app or the Apple clients play from it.
The sideloaded iPhone and iPad build leaves out the Apple Watch app, which would use up another of your free app slots.
